title: First-order linear kernel containing a Bertini singular fibre
statement: Let k be a field, Y smooth over k with structure morphism f, L invertible, and s_0,...,s_r generating L. Suppose the associated morphism Y -> P^r_k of [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections] is an immersion. Let Z and p:Z -> Y be the reduced singular scheme and its projection from [def-zl-bertini-universal-family]. Every point y has an affine neighbourhood U smooth of some relative dimension d over k such that for every z in U there is a surjective kappa(z)-linear map E:kappa(z)^(r+1) -> kappa(z) plus kappa(z)^d and a closed immersion of the scheme-theoretic fibre (p|_U)_z into Spec(Sym_{kappa(z)}((ker E)^dual)). Its composite with the coefficient map, defined on polynomial generators by coordinate functionals restricted to ker E and on k by the residue-field map of U -> Spec k, is the original coefficient projection of this fibre. Invertibility and fibres use [def-sc-invertible-module] and [def-pc-scheme-fibre].

proof.text: Choose an affine smooth chart of constant relative dimension d using Smooth.exists_smoothOfRelativeDimension_resLE. Compose with the base affine-open inclusion; its relative dimension is zero, so the structure map of U has relative dimension d.
Apply bertini_singular_fibre_kernel on this fixed affine U for every z. The coefficient-map compatibility and closed immersion are exactly those of that theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem bertini_singular_first_order_model
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (r : ℕ)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm (fun i ↦
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L) (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i)))))
    [IsImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) f L
      (fun i ↦ (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L)
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i))) hgen)] :
    ∀ y : Y, ∃ U : Y.Opens, y ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ d : ℕ, SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (U.ι ≫ f) ∧
        ∀ z : U, ∃ E : (Fin (r + 1) → (U : Scheme).residueField z) →ₗ[
            (U : Scheme).residueField z]
            (U : Scheme).residueField z × (Fin d → (U : Scheme).residueField z),
          Function.Surjective E ∧
          ∃ j : (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z ⟶
              Spec (CommRingCat.of (SymmetricAlgebra ((U : Scheme).residueField z)
                (Module.Dual ((U : Scheme).residueField z) E.ker))),
            IsClosedImmersion j ∧
            j ≫ bertiniLinearKernelCoefficientMap ((U.ι ≫ f).residueFieldAlgebraMap z) E =
              (bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiberι z ≫
                ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s) ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫
                (bertiniSingularIdeal f L s).subschemeι ≫ bertiniUniversalProjection f L s
